reviews.text: Friendly and professional staff  . What more could you want from a vet.
The staff in this vets where so kind and helpful, the vet was great told me what he was doing and how much it was going to be. Great service.
Excellent service.
Very polite and friendly staff  .the vets made my dog at ease.
Lovely staff, great service and helpful advise. So happy to have found somewhere affordable with such caring vets.
First class vets wish I knew about it sooner but I’ll not be going anywhere from now on.

It was easy to make an appointment and the vet was very knowledgeable. Also the receptionist was very friendly.
Amazing value for money, I wish we found out earlier about them!
Lovely team who clearly care about my pet. They look after everything, from check-ups to specialist treatment, so I always feel in safe hands.
We went today for the first time with our 9 weeks old puppy for his first set of injections,the vet was very lovely and explained everything

Took my dog to the vets as she had hurt her leg, the Vet thoroughly examined her, asked some questions and reassured me that she was fine but would give me some antibiotics as the injury was on the joint and they would prevent any infection. Throughly satisfied with the outcome.

The vet examined my cat thoroughly and helped relieve her painful symptoms. Everyone was kind, caring and professional, and I felt that my cat was in very good hands. Thank you so much for your help and care! ❤️

I was let down by my previous vet so thought carefully about who I would transfer the care of my 2 cats to. Animal Trust Vets CIC are a breath of fresh air - I know, from the first visit, that Animal Trust Vets really are a vet practice that can be trusted. The clinic was exceptionally clean throughout and all staff were careing and welcoming. They are not the kind of practice that focuses on the end of day takings.
Dog was seen on same day and problem resolved in practice.

A massive thank you to everyone at Animal Trust Ibrox for looking after our dog today. Every member of staff we spoke to was amazing, kind and reassuring, making myself, my partner and our two kids feel completely at ease leaving her with them.
They took such great care of our girl and saved us an absolute fortune too, which we’re incredibly grateful for. We honestly can’t thank the whole team enough! ❤️🐾

Had first experience of this facility today attending due to my friends cat.
On arrival the first thing I noticed was a good vibe from the reception area and Donna the receptionist,a calm setting which put both pets and owners at ease.
The vet we seen for Lily the cat was Gethin who had explained in layman's terms her diagnosis,and the care and attention provided by the team.
This gem of a service is not getting the accolades it deserves !.
Being an owner of a few cats myself,this will 💯 my go to for a fantastic vetrinary treatment 😀 👍.
Thanks team.

Invaluable service, amazing staff - everyone in interacted with was brilliant and you’ve taken a weight off my shoulders reassuring me with next steps and symptoms to look out for. Sick pets is always going to be distressing but I am so grateful for the reassurance and amazing service from the team. Prices were upfront and entirely reasonable.  Taking a pet to the vet can be scary but it couldn’t have been smooth - I couldn’t be more grateful.
Staff are amazing with Elliot. Cannot fault them at all. Gethyn the vet was great with him and explained everything so clearly to me. Would 100% reccommend Animal Trust.
Friendly service
Always reassuring & professional
Beautiful experience lovely clean place staff and vet were amazing so glad I left my last vet as you had to wait weeks in here you book online so easy to use

Animal Trust, is without a doubt the best Vets, I have been to.  The Vet treated my little pom, he has a skin condition, they diagnosed what it was, (been to other vets, they could not figure out what was causing it) but, with some medication, he is so much happier, and on the mend.  Would highly recommend, 10/10, the receptionists, are always kind and very professional, treatment was excellent, and without the consultation fee, made a huge difference in price.  Excellent Veterinary Practice!!!
I can’t thank gethins enough for what he’s done for my boy mylo.
Fantastic vets with incredible ethos. Free thorough consultation because they want everyone to have access to pet care. Great staff and reception area. I won’t be going anywhere else from now on.

Refreshing to feel that it's all about your four legged family member and not how much money they can get out of you!  Had our cat and now our dog for a visit to get a few things checked out as he's 10 now and again a great experience. My wife signed our 2 dogs and cat up to the pet plans and we've been well impressed with the friendly, professional service. The Animal Trust Vets clinic really is a breath of fresh air with the treatment and advice they offer not to mention their pricing. Give them a visit, I think you'll be impressed!
Our westie morag needed dental work. From the minute the 1st consultation to the operation the experience was excellent stress free.

The vet listened carefully to my concerns about a lump on my dog’s leg and explained clearly what the options were, he was kind to both me and Tara so I felt reassured that I was choosing the best options for treatment.

First time here today to register and to book a procedure.Staff we're excellent. Friendly, polite and very helpful. Was fortunate enough to be able to have a consultation with a vet who was very helpful. Checked dog over and agreed on treatment required. He explained everything well and booked an appointment for the procedure.
Was really happy with my visit. Everyone was really helpful.
Thank you.

Absolutely blown away by how amazing this vets practice is and how they don’t want to take a kidney for payment. My cat got seen on the day and I was immediately accepted as a customer even though I live outside Glasgow. I cannot fault what this amazing vets is doing. Owning a pet shouldn’t be a something only people with money can afford to do. Animals are therapy. I hope we see more vets with this ethos. Thank you.

I'm so happy my vet was before champions but I was not happy very small place and my youngest gsd was badly bitten in the face by small dog he was reactive and too small place but animal trust it's a plenty of the space cheaper a lot and really good doctors

Best vet practice i have ever used, no consultation fees, staff are lovely and attentive, cheapest vets by far too plus they have a fixed price list so you knw exactly what to expect regarding treatment, only thing not on the price list is the medication your pet needs but again its very reasonably priced, would happily recommend this vets to everyone I know

I had been with the same vet for 20 years but thought I would try something new. I was very impressed by the facilities, appointment availability and staff. I booked online and was seen within 24 hours the vet was warm welcoming explained all possible options and an action plan. The service was good and not overpriced or any sales tactics. I will be using this service for all future needs
Our vet Sam was empathic, knowledgeable and we felt she put our pet first whilst keeping us at the centre of the consultation.
Friendly and helpful. Kind and patient. Did not charge me. Really felt the most important thing was my dog being happy,  not selling.
Very gentle with my Wee Bella x

I have visited this veterinary practice many times before, and in the past I would have happily given them five stars. Unfortunately, after my most recent experience, I can only give two stars.

My main concern was the way the vet handled my pet. Although the vet spoke very politely and reassuringly to me, I felt that the same patience and kindness were not shown towards the animal.

When giving the injection, I felt the handling was quite rough. There did not seem to be much effort to calm my pet down, make them feel safe, or find a more comfortable position before attempting the injection. When my pet became difficult to handle and the injection was not going smoothly, I felt the approach became more forceful rather than more patient.

As a pet owner, it was genuinely upsetting to watch. I completely understand that some animals can be difficult or nervous during treatment, and I know vets sometimes have to work under challenging circumstances. However, I believe that patience, gentle handling, and knowing how to reassure a frightened animal are very important parts of veterinary care.

I have had good experiences here in the past, which is why this visit was particularly disappointing. I sincerely hope more attention can be given to how nervous or difficult animals are handled in the future.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Incredible care for nervous pets!I cannot recommend Animal Trust Glasgow Ibrox enough! I brought in my 11-year-old rescue dog, Darwin, who is absolutely terrified of the vets. We saw Gethin, who immediately put us both at ease. He made the entire visit all about Darwin—taking the time to get to know him and play with him while I explained the reason for our visit.The great experience started right at the front desk with the inviting reception staff. In fact, absolutely everyone I have come across there is lovely, friendly, and welcoming! I love their ethos and focus on accessible care. It was a fantastic visit, and I will be recommending this practice to all of my friends!
Surgery is much more appealing and welcoming since Trust took over.  Really pleased with outcome of today’s visit.  Highly recommend.

The receptionists where lovely and helpful the area was spotless and smelled lovely. The vet was very helpful  and so patient with my son as it is his dog and he has autisim she also explained very clearly what treatment Bella was going to have all and all it was a very pleasant appointment.

They saw my cat fast, got a blood test done and another apoiment to find out what's wrong with her they treated her amazingly and I learnt she likes the liver and suasges  web box treat, the staff were amazing in reception having conversations with us the people in general where extreamly nice and the vet? She was absolutely amaizng she didn't scare me with worst case scenarios and she explained eveyrthing in a way that made me understand what was happening without freaking out, I'm autistic so this was extreamly helpful blaze is eating more because of their meds I'm greatful to animal trust
Vet is great happy to help and explain everything and answer all my questions when needed.
Best vets about staff are brilliant and prices are very reasonable and affordable care for your furries
Excellent animal care vet was Excellent with my dog 🐕 thanks guys

I registered & booked an online appointment easily. It is a lovely clean vets clinic & staff were very welcoming. My dog was very anxious & vet was great discussing the dental work that I felt Alfie needed & also gave advice on how to go forward with his behaviour issues which I can think about when dental work done.

Place is wonderful.  Ditch your current vet and go here.  Lovely friendly people that are there to help you and your pet in the easiest way possible.  Not trying to rob you blind like a lot of them these days and I’ve been to quite a few.  Will never go anywhere else now.  EVER!!

Absolutely amazing pet and owner experience, as always!  Excellent friendly and professional staff from start to finish.
Highly recommend Animal Trust Vets at Ibrox, Glasgow.

After a misdiagnosis elsewhere and an overnight stay at a veterinary hospital, I brought my very sick cat to Animal Trust Ibrox, and I honestly can't thank them enough.

From the moment I walked through the door, every member of staff was amazing. They were kind, compassionate, and incredibly accommodating, immediately recognising how distressed and frightened I was at the thought of losing my cat.

The vets took the time to explain the surgery she urgently needed, talked me through the potential risks and complications, and patiently answered every question I had. I never felt rushed and always felt that she was in the very best hands.

A few hours later, which honestly felt like forever, I received the call to say her surgery had been completed successfully. Hearing that she was stable and had already eaten was the biggest relief imaginable.

We still have a road to recovery ahead, with our first post-operative check in a few days and another appointment next week, but I truly believe she wouldn't be where she is today without the incredible care she received.

Thank you to the vets, veterinary nurses, reception team, and everyone at Animal Trust Ibrox for your compassion, professionalism, and for acting so quickly when my cat needed you most. You turned one of the most frightening experiences of my life into one filled with hope, and I will be forever grateful.

The best experience I’ve ever had at a vet. My lil cat was so cared for and Julia the vet just couldn’t have been nicer. She listened and explained everything really well. A fantastic experience, so glad I took my little guy here.

Excellent service, I had a true emergency that not only my own vet could not accommodate or 3 other establishments in glasgow and surrounding areas but this place made effort to us and try their best provide care and relief to suffering dog
Vet was very patient with my nervous dog, took time to make her more comfortable and at ease. She explained poppy's treatment in easy to understand terms, would highly recommend this practice

I was limited on time with what was needed for my pet before travelling and these guys managed to book me in, in no time. Very friendly staff, attentive and caring with my pet :) definitely recommending them!

Fabulous vets and was made to feel very welcome on a first visit and the care that was shown to Pherb was very reassuring he obviously was exhausted after his visit as he slept the rest of the afternoon 🤭 …

I had a really positive experience with both of my cats being neutered here. From the initial consultation through to collection, the team were kind, caring and professional. The staff explained everything clearly and were very reassuring, which really helped as I was understandably nervous.
Having the practice just around the corner made the whole experience much less stressful for both me and my cats. It was also fantastic that they accepted the Cats Protection yellow vouchers, which covered more than I expected, including the microchips.
Both of my boys came home safely and are recovering well. My only suggestion would be that it would have been helpful to have a quick demonstration of how to fit the recovery cone, as I wasn't very confident about doing it myself. Apart from that, I couldn't fault the care they received.
Thank you to the whole team for looking after Loki and Zeus so well. 🐾🐾
My daughter in law sadly had to have her wee dog put to sleep, the staff were excellent and went beyond kindness , very calm and respectful situation , thank you from Beau’s family 🫶🏻🫶🏻🫶🏻x …
They have always been very helpful, quick to respond and transparent. I highly recommend them

With all of the stress of having a sick pet I felt we were dealt with compassion and efficiency.  You really feel they are doing there best for both your pet and you.  You do feel your pet is really cared for and were great at explaining what was going on.  They got to the bottom of an issue we were having in one visit when had been to other practices with issue still not resolved.  We cannot thank them enough for their diligence, knowledge compassion.  Was also very reasonably priced but not only saved us money on what work was don that day, saved us many unnecessary visits and cost by getting to the bottom of the issue in one visit where others could not.
Highly recommend
Fantastic service and staff , fussed over Daisy the doodle , just a great experience from start to finish, even the booking online is straightforward.

I have recently moved to this area and my first visit to Animal Trust Glasgow was fantastic.
From being seen quickly to having the vet listen to my concerns attentively while showing gentle care to my dogs resulted in an ideal appointment.
We travel quite far, this was also considered as part of the treatment plan.
The cost was less than half of the vet close to home.

My 8 month old pup had a urethral prolapse. We were so worried 😟. However, the staff and vets at animal trust really put us at ease and took the best care of our boy. They even gave a little curtsey call the day after his surgery to how he was doing. Everything has been amazing, surgery went amazing and hes now on the road to recovery. We were also extremely grateful for the cost. This was a really worry of ours. However, it was all well explained and the price was great. Can't thank you all enough especially Vet who did his surgery. I cannot remember his name unfortunately. But great guy and was amazing with adonis too 🤗

Do not go there if they say u have appointment. Have an appointment at 17.45. came exactly on time but people was in queue, then they tell You, you are late for Ur appointment. At this time I could find another vet. Never recommend, beware!!!!
Lovely staff,vet was great with my nervous cat and was very reassuring.
Excellent service.  No messing about , diagnosed and booked in right away. A successful outcome. Price fair . Thanks to the team .
Great place to take your pets staff are nice and helpful
Brilliant place. No hidden costs, very good prices, and no appointment fees. On top of that their care for my dog was fantastic. Exactly what a vets should be.
Excellent service and after care.

Brilliant experience. I changed to animal trust after having issues with unexpected/unreasonable charges at a previous vet.  My cat was looked after wonderfully by the caring and kind staff and the costs were very reasonable.

Wonderful vets and in my time of sorrow and heartbreak losing my beloved pet and best friend for over 14 and a half years these wonderful vets supported me and didn't rob me and put my beloved spike to sleep for over 70% cheaper than any local glasgow vets, god bless animals trust and wonderful people, they are angels
First visit with animal trust today, great service from start to finish , the vet explained everything well and was very good with my nervous dachshund.

The team at the Animal Trust are very friendly and welcoming.  The vets listen to your concerns, and  give your pet a through examination.  The diagnosis is explained to you in words that you can understand, and if extras like x-rays, blood tests are required,  there's no pressure on you to commit.  Excellent service
Great veterinary surgery

We need more vets like this - genuinely patient‑focused. They make decisions based solely on what’s best for the animal — not profit, not upselling,. Everything  is explained clearly, with compassion and honesty.

Animal Trust were terrific. Everything was explained brilliantly and my dog was treated so well and the vet even phoned late on a Fri evening to explain plan for his op. I won't go anywhere else now as my previous experience with vets has been more about profit as opposed to the actual care of an animal!

My 3 cats got spade at the Ibrox clinic
Nurse was very good she explained everything to me
My cats visited the clinic for their vaccines too
all the vets were amazing and comforting to them

My visit yesterday was the first to this practice.  I was very pleased with my visit and the cost for my dogs prescription was very reasonable. I would recommend bringing your pet to Animal trust Ibrox.

Taken my 2 year old labrador in for booster vaccination and the staff where brilliant. Extremely helpful. Very clean. Would highly recommend animal trust for any of your pets needs. Thank you so much for your help.

We moved to this practice last year when Abbey Vets closed. This vets are absolutely fantastic, all staff are lovely and great with the dogs. Knowledgeable and always available to answer questions and deal with emergencies.

I must say Rex my big boisterous black Labrador has formed a particular bond with Gethan. He adores him and is more excited to see him than he is some of our family 😂

Have not met one member of the team who have been anything less than amazing. Friendly, helpful, and willing to cope with 50kg of Labrador bounding into the practice and wanting to see everyone. Amazing staff,  100% recommend. Thank you and sorry for the treats going astray at reception Gillian again!

The vet was wonderful with my cat, Cassiopée, I got her medication immediately.
I have two other cats registered at another clinic (25 minutes far from G51), but I plan to transfer their records there.
Animal Trust is just a minute from my house, and I recommend it 100%, the staff is absolutely fantastic.

First time visit . 2 year old still loopy Rhodesian ridgeback for a recurring right ear infection. Staff loved and showed him plenty of affection. Did have a few issues trying to register. I’m 66 not too great with computers. A lovely lady called Donna actually registered me and Harley . So that was amazing service from the Animal trust . Very young vet . And can I just say that I’ve been to loads of vets with Harley and that’s the first time a vet has taken a sample of the gunge in his right ear for a swab and look see under the microscope on a slide . That young lady is an asset to the the charity. She actually wanted to see for herself what was going on in his ear . That’s a real vet . Back home now Harley’s back to normal now . Thanks to all the team at Animal trust and for seeing Harley at such short notice. 10/10 .
Very happy with Animal Trust. Vet explained everything that they would do to help our wee cat.

Absolutely fantastic vet.

Had my young cat in and out for various reasons over the last few months and they have been nothing short of helpful, informative and supportive.

Even if you see a different vet/nurse than you usually do, they're still extremely in the loop with any previous issues you've had with your pet.

The vets and nurses clearly enjoy their job and have so much time and respect for your pet.

Massive thanks to Gethin, Julia and Samantha for putting up with us so far, you guys are absolute assets to the team. I'm sure goose will miss yous when he decides to stop doing himself damage 😅❤️
I have used this practice for many years and they look after my dog with care and attention to detail. You never feel pressured into making decisions and always try to put Louie at ease

Animal Trust Vet are amazing and looked after my girls, the team are amazing and clearly care about the pets they look after. I could see the wee happy dogs coming in and none of the animals looked scared of a trip to the vet. Having staff that care really shines from the receptionist to the vet. An all round amazing team.
My dog is old and I took him to this vet and they told me so much I didn't know, the previous vet had never mentioned. Great vets, great value and the vet was so helpful.
Always great with the cats 😊 …

We were delighted at the reception we received My 16 yrs old Burmese cat was very well handled with gentle contact. The vet who attended to my cat was a joy , efficient and gave us very good information . We  were previous clients of Campbell Galloway and now have great faith in Animal Trust Vets who have taken over

The rating has nothing to do with the lovely lady who dealt with me on the the phone who was professional and polite,, this has to do with extortionate prices of medication.
I was looking to top up my dog’s medication by 2 tablets as I’m going on holiday and the day I come home her tablets finish that day , so the extra 2 tablets would help over me those next few days so I could order them online.
For 2 tablets I was being charged £32.50 !!!!
I pay the same price for 15 tablets online .
I’m sorry but I can’t afford to pay extortionate prices.!!!
Absolutely fantastic staff , treated amazing highly recommended, what you would expect a vets to be like , and not ripped off with costs realistically priced , Ibrox staff 10/10

Everyone was friendly and professional, the ease of making appointments was very good, when I mentioned animal trust to people while walking the dogs a lot of folk mentioned they had heard of them and how good they had heard animal trust was and also mentioned the pricing being better than most other vets.

I am so happy I found this vets. My dog LOVES going there, the service is always friendly, prompt and efficient with expert advice which always has mine and my pets best interests at heart. Easily the best vets we have registered with and used by a county mile and the bench mark that all vet’s surgery’s and services should be judged by 👏👏👏😎
Very pleased with everything from the nice welcome to the treatment Evie got. Staff very nice explaining what they were doing while treating her.

Very impressed how Professional the Vets are and how quickly they were able to give me an over alll Diagnosis. My dog has two major health issues and both were explained to me on my first appointment.
I would recommend The Animals Trust from now on to anyone over any other charity organisation that says it treats pets health.
I have dealt with many Vets over my lifetime and this is the best Veterinary care you will receive anywhere.

We normally go to the pdsa at shamrock St,  but was advised that to look for a 2nd opinion on our dog snowys condition,  and only today his condition got worse,  so my sarha phoned Animal trust, at govan ,explained his symptoms and they said,  to take him in tomorrow morning   but once sarha explained that we just lost our other boy in February and was panicking over snowy,  so they managed to fit us in tonight and they came up with a plan for the better for snowy.  From the phone call , the girls at the desk , the nurse and eventually the vet called Sam,  we could not wish for a better , caring group of people,  Sam took time to examine snowy and come up with a plan to make sure everything was investigated and to find a solution,  we can't thank to team enough,  and we both felt a great weight was lifted off our shoulders.

The reception staff couldn’t be any nicer 10/10. My emergency appointment was with a Guinea pig and although here wasn't well equipped to deal with them, the vet took there time to examine him and give best advice and treatment possible and explained my opinions clearly with care. I would highly recommend this place. If I were to quibble i may have be at fault also, prices wernt explained before medication but I may have gave off care was more important. And the first question of care or sleep was a bit much for me. I understand the question but in an emotional emergency appointment maybe there’s a better way.

Had to take my very nervous border collie Corrie to the Animal Trust vet’s practice before Christmas after he managed to lodge a stick in his throat whilst out walking . I was so impressed with everyone we came into contact with professional, compassionate  and extremely helpful.  Corrie was very well looked after and examined under sedation then vet called to give update . At a cost way less than I have ever paid . This is the best overall experience I have had at a vets and Corrie is nearly 9 . Well done Animal Trust  Highly recommend wonderful staff. I discovered this review had not posted in December so I am posting this now before latest review
All staff are amazing and friendly and very welcoming

I have a indoor cat called sally who loves the vet nurse sally king the vets vet nurses and reception staff are absolutely 💯 outstanding and nothing is a problem to the staff I highly recommend Animal trust vets formerly known as campbell and Galloway thankyou for your service its appreciated!👍 …
The best vet practice i have ever been to,and I have been to a few,easy appointments and a great vet easy to talk to and very knowledgeable.
The vets and staff at animal trust are fantastic took care of my boy and put our minds at ease can't thank you enough

What an amazing clinic. We brought our 11 year dog in last week for a second option on dental work required. He had developed an abscess and his registered veterinary clinic had quoted us for dental extractions under GA. We got an appt with Animal trust so quickly and on a Saturday which was idea, also a free consultation, they quoted us for the same treatment which was over £1000 less. Just as it states online the price is fixed. His dental work cost just over £500 when we were quoted £1523 from our local vet. The vet carrying out his GA was so amazing and the nurses were fantastic. So welcoming when coming in for both our visits. The care he received was just amazing. He’s back home tonight and already munching into his dinner. They have booked us back in for a review a few days later just to check up on him. Cannot recommend this vets enough and have already passed on their details to friends & family. Can’t thank them enough for caring so well for our pup and also for being so much more affordable

Animal trust was recommended by a friend and they didn’t disappoint . The care and attention from the vet and staff was exceptional. My pet was treated with kindness and compassion. I would recommend animal trust to anyone who needs an honest upfront vet. Pricing is very fair and no hidden fees.

First visit to Animal Trust with my cat.  Gethin, the vet was absolutely lovely and brilliant at explaining things in a way that was easy to understand. The possible cost was also very clearly explained.  I can't recommend him highly enough.

Been going there for year's on and off with my dog's staff are always welcome you all the time they even help me out with my beagle cross I got from the dog's trust as he came with a  booklet I never understood the vet had a read at and there was a part for the dog's trust can help me with a  on going condition and the content the dog's trust on my behalf and got it all sorted for me recommended them to anyone
Very friendly helpful staff. They took great care of our dog and explained everything clearly to us that was required for her procedure. Good prices too, far more reasonable than our usual vet.

We could not be more grateful for vet Calum and the rest of the amazing team. Our beautiful 5month old puppy was ran over by a jogger and broke her front leg. We were so upset this had happened, however the care provided by the team made us feel our wee girl was in the best hands. After a successful surgery, Freya is recovering and in good spirits, she even enjoyed visiting again for her post-op review. Pricing was fair and transparent. Overall best outcome we could have hoped for and we recommend them wholeheartedly 🤍

So, we decided to the take one of our Puglets in for dental work. We were attracted by the fair and transparent pricing in comparison to our previous vet surgery. The process was easy. We booked a consultation then booked him in for dental surgery. Our wee fella seemed in knowledgeable, safe and professional hands. The surgery went well despite mild complications and we were kept informed throughout.
It was heartwarming to see how well our wee guy was treated during recover, as any pet owner knows how important it is for their wee ones to be in caring and compassionate hands.
Our wee guy continues to improve through his recovery and we'll definitely be back for  all our vet needs.
Big thanks to all involved.

I took my Lhasa Apso Mylo twice to this vets, The staff are very friendly from the off, Most vets are all about the money but not Animal Trust their prescriptions prices are very reasonable & NO consultation fees is game changing, Iv recommended to everyone i know with a cat/dog to take their pet there when its unwell.❤️
Staff are brilliant. So kind and patient with my little dog. Easy to get advice and speak to someone.
Took great care of our dog.

Really clean, good service, nice people. Good idea where you don't pay for the consultation but do pay for meds or tests, ours was £6 for cat painkiller. Highly recommend. Will bring kitten for microchip, £27.

Seen vet gethin at short notice today with my poorly spaniel
He was friendly caring and helpful especially aince my dog was distressed and in pain and got my dog sorted with some medication
Exeptional care and would absolutely recommend this place

I honestly couldn’t recommend The Animal Trust Glasgow Vet highly enough. From the moment we arrived, the staff were absolutely amazing — so friendly, approachable, and helpful.

Their not-for-profit ethos, ensuring animals can access the care they need, is truly incredible and something I’m so grateful exists.

My 8 year old dog recently had a dental clean and extractions, and the care she received was outstanding. From the pre-op stage right through to the lovely phone call I received once her procedure was finished, the communication was fantastic.

I was very worried about the anaesthetic, so the reassurance and updates meant the world to me. The compassion shown wasn’t just for my dog, but for me as well, and that really stood out.

I’m absolutely over the moon to have found such a special place and haven’t stopped recommending them to every pet owner I know.

Thank you so much to everyone at The Animal Trust Glasgow for everything you’ve done for my dog and for putting my mind at ease. Truly a wonderful, special place.
They treat my kittens so well and so gently! Great staff and my cats like going there so that makes life easier for me :)

One word....Exceptional! A friendly & knowledgeable team of professionals that really do care for their "patients". The focus is purely on the care & wellbeing of the animals throughout rather than just profit based which seems to be how some veterinary practices operate these days, a sign of the times, sadly.

I've already recommended them to a number of friends & would urge anyone reading this review to register their pet & do the same. An outstanding Veterinary Practice. Merry Christmas to all the Team & best wishes to one & all for 2026!

From a very satisfied customer........& lots of love from "Little A"

Literally can’t thank this vets practice enough! If it wasn’t for them I didn’t know how I was going to afford my dogs dental work. They looked after him so well. I’m so grateful to all the staff for being so kind and also being able to book him in so quickly. Thank you

Really pleased to have found this vet. We've brought both cats there and they've been wonderful. One cat is super anxious and the vet did all they could to keep them calm during their visit. Really appreciated that they went out of their way to make it less stressful for her.

Since changing from Campbell & Galloway, they have changed how they bill for surgery. Formerly, you would attend, they would advise on what would be needed, do the work and claim against the insurance themselves and then the owner would pay the remainder. Now you have to put up 2/3s of the surgery cost upfront and arrange the insurance stuff yourselves. This was not advised on the switch over. As such, I'm looking for another vet practice. Not necessarily due to said change but the lack of communication about that. P.s. None of this is the blame of the staff there. I was recommended this vet by a dog walker a few years ago and finally switched over after I felt my dog’s issues weren’t being addressed at the old vet. First impressions: great service over the phone arranging appointment; on arrival, receptionist lovely and tried to make my nervous dog feel comfortable with treats; vet Sam super nice and professional - carried out a full investigation and found my poor baby had an ear infection (the old vet hadn’t looked in my dogs ears once despite 3 visits in the 4 weeks preceding seeing Sam) while also giving me a list of things to try for her issues which might prevent expensive testing in the future. And now just over a week later my wee dog is back to her usual self and I couldn’t be happier.
Advice to anyone reading this, if you’re not getting the service you think you should then don’t stick with the same vet out of loyalty or routine. I wish I changed vets sooner!
